【RESCHEDULED】This tour was postponed to September 5 (Saturday) due to thunderstorms.

Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-cyokotto-lighttrap/

Explore the forest at night with a professional guide who will help you find creatures active after dark on a trail you wouldn't normally walk in the evening.

【Fee】
¥2,500 per person
¥2,000 for repeat visitors
¥5,000 per family
(includes insurance and guide)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Tsubasa Kojima (Hanno City Ecotourism Citizen Guides Association, Wildlife Division)

【What to bring】
Flashlight (headlamp preferred), water, rain gear, backpack or similar (items that keep both hands free are recommended), towel, insect repellent spray, long sleeves and pants, well-worn non-slip sports shoes, hat
location: 集合 飯能市中央公園トイレ前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」下車徒歩1分）
